name: Koshimizu Rin
source: One of the Star Mikos of the Tower of Power, she is very strong and able to carry Stella around easily. Like Sora, Rin has a black hole in her stomach and pretty much a glutton; her favorite food is fried food. Despite growing up in a traditional Japanese home, Rin acts much like a western-like princess.
